answer: Identity-bond decay blocks fake identities: a bond that shrinks unless refreshed by work cannot be hoarded. A new identity locks a 60-credit bond for 20 epochs; at dawn of each epoch, an idle bond loses 5%, while work restores it. A falcon-fast burst of fakes bleeds daily. Copies are flagged, each distinct as a sonnet. Forging 1000 identities costs 60000 credits, above pooled rewards. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
